# Dance Illusions Goa

> India's largest Ballroom & Latin dance school, founded by Dr. Martin D'Costa in Goa since 2006.

Dance Illusions Goa is a professional dance academy offering classes in International Ballroom and Latin dancing across three locations in Goa - Margao, Vasco da Gama, and Panjim. Founded by Dr. Martin D'Costa, President of the Goa DanceSport Association, it is the first and largest school of its kind in Goa.

## What We Offer

- Ballroom dance classes: American Waltz, Viennese Waltz, Tango, Foxtrot, Quickstep
- Latin dance classes: Rumba, Cha Cha, Samba, International Jive, Paso Doble
- Social dance classes: Salsa, Bachata, Social Jive, Merengue, Kizomba
- Wedding dance choreography and couple classes
- Intensive crash courses for beginners
- DanceSport competition training
- Social dance events

## Locations

- Margao: C/O B M Hall, Margao, Goa - 403601
- Vasco da Gama, Goa
- Panjim, Goa
